relational_obstruction: The large-radius observable Lambda_chi cannot distinguish a nonzero local state from zero when the state has finite global kinetic energy, because the R^-1 normalization annihilates every L2 state.
must_break: finite-energy kernel / sublinear large-radius energy growth
transfer_boundary: This obstruction transfers only after checking that the proposed observable has the same kernel and that the target source class does not already exclude finite-energy/coherent states.
falsifier: A theorem proving every source-realizable F=1 blow-up limit obeys limsup_R R^-1 int chi_R |u|^2 >= c>0 would close this obstruction for that source class.
